# coolify_server_resources (Data Source)

Every workload (application, database, service) defined on a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_server_resources" "main" {
  server_uuid = data.coolify_server.main.uuid
}

output "running_workloads" {
  value = [for r in data.coolify_server_resources.main.resources : r.name
  if startswith(r.status, "running")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) Workloads on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.
- `type` (String) Workload type.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
